display.title: The Twelve Pesukim, Number Three: Bechol Dor Vador
display.summary_short: Uncle Yossi introduces the third of the Twelve Pesukim, Bechol Dor Vador: in every generation each Jew should feel as if he himself went out of Egypt.
display.summary_long: A short teaching from the Tzivos Hashem radio show. Uncle Yossi reminds listeners that every member of Tzivos Hashem is to know the Twelve Pesukim by heart, say them every day and get friends to say them too. After Torah Tziva and Shema Yisroel comes number three, Bechol Dor Vador. He translates it phrase by phrase: in each and every generation, every person must look upon himself as if he himself went out of Egypt, and so thank Hashem at all times for freeing us from slavery. He adds that there are many lovely tunes to this pasuk, because we want to sing it over and over again. The clip ends just as the Hakochainik march is about to begin.
display.lesson: Every day, feel as if you yourself were freed from Egypt, and thank Hashem for it.

date.note: Clip of episode 163, dated from its cues: the week before episode 164, which says 'tomorrow night is Rosh Chodesh Adar' (19 Feb 1985).
